title: Additions
description: Optional fitting choice. Useful parts, resource-gathering options, and other oddities that make life on the waves easier.

options.name: Anchor System
options.description: Lengths of chain with heavy curved hooks, used to anchor the ship to branches of the Wildsea.
options.special: Almost every ship comes with this as standard.

options.name: Rig-Ropes
options.description: Ropes strung up above the deck for climbing, safety lines, or drying washing.

options.name: Firefly Lanterns
options.description: A network of lanterns whose glowing inhabitants are woken or sent to sleep with a tap on the glass.
options.special: Can illuminate any part of the ship.

options.name: Luminous Blooms
options.description: Patches of moss or flowering plants that shed pale light in the darker hours.

options.name: Chemical Spotlight
options.description: A light that illuminates surrounding areas with day-like clarity.

options.name: Survival Station
options.description: A station containing flares, flags, grapples, wraps, and emergency rations.

options.name: Cargo Crane
options.description: A sturdy crane for loading and unloading cargo, capable of carrying extremely heavy objects.

options.name: Wrecker's Magnet
options.description: A curious electromagnetic crane often used by salvagers, with controls for the magnetism.

options.name: Signal Flares
options.description: Colour-coded flares fired into the heavens to communicate findings, threats, and positioning.
options.special: Requires at least a smattering of the Signalling language to use effectively.

options.name: Shutter-Lamps
options.description: A bank of lights and shutters for blinking visual signals across vast distances.
options.special: Requires at least a smattering of the Signalling language to use effectively.

options.name: Steam Whistle
options.description: A shrill, piercing whistle used to announce presence or scare skittish denizens of the sea.

options.name: Vox-Horn
options.description: A deep, blaring horn that can also be used as an effective voice amplifier.

options.name: Tethered Kitesail
options.description: A glider tethered to the deck with a long rope, allowing aerial exploration on windy days.

options.name: Trained Messengers
options.description: Flying creatures trained to seek out distant landmasses or nearby ships, deliver messages, and return with replies.
options.special: Specify the type of creature when chosen.

options.name: Fixed-Band Radio
options.description: A short-range radio system capable of sending and receiving static-laden signals, based on pre-verdant technology.
options.special: Relies on fragile antennae affixed to the uppermost part of the ship.

options.name: Fruiting Tree
options.description: An ancient tree rooted to the deck, laden with fast-growing fruit.
options.special: Automatically acquire a fruit-based specimen when you tend to the fruiting tree.

options.name: Night Farm
options.description: A dark, covered soilpit for growing mushrooms.
options.special: Automatically acquire a mushroom-based specimen when you tend to the night farm.

options.name: Lightning Rod
options.description: A multi-pronged metal array for attracting lightning and storing it in ceramic batteries.
options.special: Automatically acquire a charged ceramic battery when the ship enters a lightning storm.

options.name: Water Purifier
options.description: A funnel filtration system for producing clean water.
options.special: Automatically acquire a barrel of fresh water with the 'Pure' tag when you drop anchor or cut a path in rainy conditions.

options.name: Trawler Nets
options.description: Reinforced nets draped over the sides of the ship to catch larger insects and small mammals.
options.special: Automatically acquire one normal specimen when you cut a path.
